snippet.title: Bus Flipper: Renovator Simulator Release Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2174560/Bus_Flipper_Renovator_Simulator/
Have you ever wondered “What if I buy an old bus and convert it into a camper? Or maybe a cafe on wheels?”. This bus conversion simulator will give you that! You will get a variety of different buses and vans to convert. Clean, destroy, create, customize, test it, sell and make profit!
